translations.idiomatic: Guoliang died of his wounds, received generous posthumous honors, and was given the posthumous title Resolute and Robust.

sentences.zh: 廷桂，廣東歸善人。

translations.literal: Tinggui was a native of Guishan in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Tinggui came from Guishan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 由行伍擢千總。

translations.literal: From the ranks he was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks to company commander.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，從征台灣，累遷海門營參將。

translations.literal: In the Qianlong reign he followed the campaign in Taiwan and was repeatedly promoted to brigade commander of the Haimen Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he campaigned in Taiwan and rose in succession to brigade commander of the Haimen Garrison.

sentences.zh: 國良歿，護理左翼鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When Guoliang died he acted as regional commander of the Left Wing Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: When Guoliang died he served in an acting capacity as regional commander of the Left Wing Garrison.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擊殲匪首總兵保於外洋，圍其餘黨。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he attacked and destroyed the bandit chief Zongbing Bao in the outer seas and surrounded the rest of his faction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1809 he destroyed the bandit chief Zongbing Bao in the open sea and surrounded the rest of his faction.

sentences.zh: 張保仔率大隊來援。

translations.literal: Zhang Baozi led a large force to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baozi led a large relief force.

sentences.zh: 眾寡不敵，廷桂死之。

translations.literal: They were too few to match the enemy, and Tinggui died.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered, Tinggui was killed.

sentences.zh: 賜卹，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Condolence gifts were granted and he was given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Condolence gifts were granted and his family received the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Commandant.

sentences.zh: 洎蔡牽既滅，惟粵匪存，於是百齡為兩廣總督，乃斷接濟，整軍紀，越一年，剿撫以次定。

translations.literal: By the time Cai Qian had been destroyed, only the Guangdong bandits remained; then Bailin became governor-general of the two Guang provinces, cut off supplies, tightened military discipline, and within a year suppression and amnesty settled them in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Once Cai Qian was destroyed, only Guangdong bandits remained. Bailin became governor-general of the two Guang provinces, severed their supply lines, tightened military discipline, and within a year settled them through suppression and amnesty in turn.

sentences.zh: 東南海氛始靖。

translations.literal: The maritime troubles of the southeast then began to be pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The southeastern coast was finally pacified.

sentences.zh: 論曰：東南海寇之擾，始末十有餘年。

translations.literal: The commentary says: The disturbance of the southeastern sea bandits lasted from beginning to end more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The historian comments: The southeastern pirate disturbances lasted more than ten years from start to finish.

sentences.zh: 惟浙師李長庚一人能辦賊，以閩帥牽掣而阻成功，然長庚忠誠勇略聞於海內，上結主知，廟算既孚，乃專倚畀。

translations.literal: Only the Zhejiang officer Li Changgeng alone could deal with the bandits; Fujian commanders held him back and blocked success, yet Changgeng's loyalty, courage, and strategy were known throughout the realm; above he won the ruler's trust, and once court plans were in accord he was relied on exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: Only Li Changgeng of the Zhejiang fleet could truly suppress the pirates, though Fujian commanders hampered him and blocked final success. His loyalty, courage, and strategic skill were known throughout the empire; he won the emperor's trust, and once court strategy aligned with his methods the throne relied on him alone.

sentences.zh: 洎閩、浙合力，賊勢浸衰，不幸長庚中殞，而王得祿、邱良功等以部將承其遺志，卒殲渠魁。

translations.literal: When Fujian and Zhejiang united their strength the bandits' power gradually declined; unfortunately Changgeng was struck down in mid-course, but Wang Delu, Qiu Lianggong, and others as subordinate commanders inherited his purpose and in the end destroyed the ringleader.
translations.idiomatic: Once Fujian and Zhejiang combined forces the pirates weakened steadily. Changgeng fell in battle, but his subordinates Wang Delu and Qiu Lianggong carried on his purpose and finally destroyed the ringleader.

sentences.zh: 粵將惟黃標可用，而未盡其才。

translations.literal: Among Guangdong generals only Huang Biao was usable, yet his talent was not fully employed.
translations.idiomatic: Among Guangdong commanders only Huang Biao was truly capable, yet his talents were never fully used.

sentences.zh: 百齡乘閩、浙殄賊之後，剿撫兼施，遂如摧枯拉朽。

translations.literal: Bailin, riding the moment after Fujian and Zhejiang had exterminated the bandits, used both suppression and amnesty, and it was then like breaking dry wood and pulling rotten stakes.
translations.idiomatic: After Fujian and Zhejiang had destroyed the main pirate forces, Bailin applied both suppression and amnesty, and the remaining Guangdong bandits collapsed like dry timber.

sentences.zh: 要之海戰惟恃船堅砲利，與斷接濟而已，循之則勝，違之則敗。

translations.literal: In sum, naval warfare depends only on stout ships and powerful cannon, and on cutting off supplies; follow this and you win, violate it and you lose.
translations.idiomatic: In short, naval warfare depends on stout ships, powerful cannon, and severing supply lines. Follow that formula and you win; ignore it and you lose.

sentences.zh: 得失之林，故無幸哉！

translations.literal: The forest of gain and loss—thus there is no luck!
translations.idiomatic: Success and failure followed that pattern—there was no room for chance.
